safeZones.name: North Quad Assembly Field
safeZones.description: Open grass quad free from building collapse perimeter. Primary evacuation zone for North Campus.

safeZones.name: East Perimeter Emergency Exit & Triage
safeZones.description: Direct unobstructed road access for municipal emergency responders and vehicle evacuation.

safeZones.name: West Athletics Shelter & High Ground
safeZones.description: Reinforced interior pavilion on elevated grade, equipped with independent HEPA air filters.

safeZones.name: South Gate Plaza Evacuation Station
safeZones.description: South vehicular egress point onto city arterial boulevard.

emergencyTypes.name: Tsunami Warning
emergencyTypes.instructions: Inundation risk detected. Immediately evacuate uphill or proceed to designated high-ground structural shelters. Avoid low coastal and drainage corridors.

emergencyTypes.name: Earthquake Alert
emergencyTypes.instructions: DROP, COVER, AND HOLD ON. Protect your head. After shaking stops, evacuate structurally compromised buildings to designated open-air assembly quads. Watch for fallen power lines.

emergencyTypes.name: Wildfire Evacuation
emergencyTypes.instructions: Rapidly approaching brush fire and ember storm. Evacuate immediately downwind away from dry vegetation. Cover mouth and nose with damp cloth. Head to East Perimeter Exit.

emergencyTypes.name: Extreme Heat Advisory
emergencyTypes.instructions: Dangerous wet-bulb temperature exceeding safety limits. Limit outdoor exposure. Hydrate at emergency water stations and seek air-conditioned indoor cooling centers.

emergencyTypes.name: Flash Flood Warning
emergencyTypes.instructions: Rapid surface water runoff and flash flooding across campus lowlands. Do not attempt to walk through moving water. Move to upper building floors or elevated terrain.

emergencyTypes.name: Severe Thunderstorm / Lightning
emergencyTypes.instructions: Severe cloud-to-ground lightning and microburst winds. Immediately cease all outdoor activities and seek fully enclosed, grounded buildings. Avoid open fields and tall trees.

emergencyTypes.name: High Wind Hazard
emergencyTypes.instructions: Gale-force gusts exceeding 65 mph. Beware of flying structural debris, falling branches, and broken glass facades. Stay indoors away from exterior windows.

emergencyTypes.name: Volcanic Ash / Pyroclastic Alert
emergencyTypes.instructions: Heavy abrasive ashfall and toxic sulfur gases. Wear particle masks (N95+). Seal building ventilation intakes and seek shelter in designated filtration pavilions.

emergencyTypes.name: Hazardous Materials (HazMat) Spill
emergencyTypes.instructions: Toxic chemical vapor plume reported. Evacuate UPWIND and cross-wind immediately. Do not touch unidentified substances. Allow HazMat response teams right-of-way.

emergencyTypes.name: Severe Air Quality Emergency
emergencyTypes.instructions: Hazardous Air Quality Index (AQI > 300) due to smoke inversion. Individuals with respiratory conditions must remain indoors. Use HEPA filtered safe buildings.

emergencyTypes.name: Radiation Threat / Incident
emergencyTypes.instructions: Radiological contamination detected. Implement TIME, DISTANCE, and SHIELDING protocols. Proceed to designated reinforced concrete basements and subterranean shelters immediately.

emergencyTypes.name: Public Health Emergency
emergencyTypes.instructions: Biohazard containment perimeter active. Follow physical distancing protocols, don appropriate personal protective equipment, and report to Health Center for screening.
